extracted.name: Easy Caramel Apple Salad
extracted.description: Butterscotch pudding, apples, peanuts, and whipped topping are folded together into an easy caramel apple salad.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
1 (3.4 ounce) package instant butterscotch pudding mix
instruction_lines: Stir whipped topping, pineapple, and butterscotch pudding mix together in a large bowl until smooth.
Fold apples and peanuts into pudding mixture until mixture is well combined.
